description: This file defines the core Framework class for the OrangeHRM application, extending Symfony's HttpKernel. It handles configuration of dependency injection, routing, logging, and request processing for the HRM system.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: Main application kernel extending Symfony's HttpKernel, managing configuration, routing, logging, and request handling for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Sets up dependency injection container with core services.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Initializes the logging subsystem and subscribes to log events.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Configures routing and URL generation components based on the incoming request.

methods.name: configurePlugins
methods.description: Initializes application plugins as per configuration.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests, setting up routing and plugins before delegating to parent handler.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Indicates whether debug mode is enabled.
